title: Many Paths to the Same Mistake: Generating Diverse Reasoning Paths Behind the Same Student Mistake
abstract: arXiv:2611.18609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Realistic evaluation of AI systems requires user simulators that capture not only cooperative behavior, but also the errors and variability that arise in real interactions. In educational technology, simulating step-by-step flawed student reasoning is essential, yet datasets mapping these pathways are scarce, and Large Language Models (LLMs) often auto-correct rather than sustain simulated mistakes. To address this, we present a generate-and-filter pipeline that produces diverse and realistic student error traces. Our approach utilizes forward consistency, a metric verifying if a flawed reasoning trace can be used to recover the student's actual incorrect answer, paired with an LLM-as-a-judge to ensure realism. Our evaluation suggests that while many LLMs struggle to maintain incorrect reasoning mid-trace, smaller supervised fine-tuned models successfully capture these divergent paths. translated_title: 通往同一错误的多种路径：生成同一学生错误背后的多样化推理路径
translated_abstract: 对AI系统进行真实的评估，需要用户模拟器不仅能够捕捉合作行为，还能捕捉真实交互中出现的错误与变异性。在教育技术领域，模拟学生逐步出错的有缺陷推理过程至关重要，然而映射这些推理路径的数据集十分匮乏，且大语言模型（LLM）往往倾向于自动纠错，而非持续保持所模拟的错误。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个生成-过滤流水线，用于产生多样且真实的学生错误推理轨迹。我们的方法利用“前向一致性”这一指标——即验证一条有缺陷的推理轨迹能否用于还原学生实际的错误答案——并结合LLM作为评判者以确保真实性。我们的评估表明，尽管许多LLM难以在推理过程中持续保持错误推理，但经过监督微调的较小模型能够成功捕捉这些分歧路径。这项工作为高保真的错误模拟提供了一个框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一个利用前向一致性指标和LLM评判机制的生成-过滤流水线，用于生成多样且真实的学生错误推理轨迹，并发现经过监督微调的较小模型比大型LLM更擅长持续保持错误推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generate-and-filter pipeline leveraging forward consistency and LLM-as-a-judge to produce diverse and realistic student error reasoning traces, showing that smaller supervised fine-tuned models outperform larger LLMs at sustaining erroneous reasoning.
